Package client

Class ChatClient

java.lang.Object
ocsf.client.AbstractClient
client.ChatClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ChatClient extends ocsf.client.AbstractClient
OCSF client that handles all communication with the GoNature server.

routes each incoming Message to the appropriate static field so that the GUI thread (blocked in handleMessageFromClientUI(Message)) can read the result after awaitResponse is cleared.

static fields act as a shared-memory rendezvous between the OCSF reader thread (which writes) and the JavaFX GUI thread (which reads after the blocking call returns).

    • awaitResponse

      public static volatile boolean awaitResponse
      set to true before sending; cleared by the response handler to unblock the GUI. declared volatile so the OCSF reader thread's write is immediately visible to the JavaFX/background thread that is polling it in handleMessageFromClientUI(logic.Message).
